residency_requirement: Indian resident; treatment in India only
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Hospital Cash benefit has 3-day waiting period; daily compensation from day 4 of hospitalisation up to 15 days

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent up to 0.5% of SI/day; ICU 1% of SI/day; doctor fees and other expenses each up to 15% of SI per any-one-illness; total modern-treatment cap 50% of SI per any-one-illness

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Modern Treatments list of 12 (robotic surgery, stem cell therapy, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty etc.) up to 50% of SI per procedure

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Rs 2,500 for normal delivery and Rs 5,000 for caesarean/extra-uterine delivery
maternity_coverage.notes: 12-month waiting period; one delivery per lifetime; expenses must be incurred as in-patient in India; voluntary termination of pregnancy in first 12 weeks excluded

newborn_coverage.notes: Newborn baby (up to 90 days) covered when maternity claim is admitted

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in qualified AYUSH Hospital or Day Care Centre

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care (Excl 05)
Spectacles, Contact Lens, Hearing Aid, Cochlear Implants
notable_exclusions_summary: Cover restricted to India. Standard IRDAI exclusion list applies (cosmetic, fertility, addiction, change-of-gender, congenital external anomalies, vaccinations, dental, vision aids).
claim_process_summary: Pre-authorisation via TPA: 72 hrs before planned hospitalisation or within 24 hrs of emergency. Cashless TAT 1 hour for pre-auth, 3 hours for final bill. Reimbursement documents within 30 days of discharge. Company offers settlement within 15 days and pays within 7 days of acceptance; 2% above bank rate interest payable on delay.
